revision.title: ETH Daily Security: Getting Ethereum Users to the Tools That Protect Them
revision.summary: Ethereum security builders ship good tools, and most users never hear about them. Under this initiative, ETH Daily will transition from a general news briefing to a security-focused publication, and will use its existing audience to send users to Ethereum security tools. Every link to external tools will be tracked, so the clicks sent to each tool can be counted and reported publicly.

sections.why:
Builders keep shipping tools that stop attacks: approval revokers, wallets that check signatures and transactions. A tool only protects the users who find it. Users have no central place to learn what exists and how to use it. They scramble to search X, GitHub and Reddit.

Wallet drainers took $494 million from 332,000 addresses in 2024 and $83.85 million from 106,106 wallets in 2025 (Scam Sniffer annual reports, drops.scamsniffer.io). Users who revoke bad approvals, check signatures and verify addresses they interact with can avoid these attacks. The best security layer is the preventive layer.
sections.in_scope:
- ETH Daily becomes a security-focused Ethereum publication for the grant period
- A public hub of security tools and guides on token approvals, wallet signatures and address poisoning
- Guides and podcast episodes that send the audience to the hub
- A published neutrality policy
sections.out_scope:
- Building security tools
- Onboarding tool teams: we bring users to teams that already exist
- Coverage of chains other than Ethereum
- Verifying what users do inside a tool after they click
sections.team: ETH Daily (pseudonymous): solo producer of a daily Ethereum news podcast, newsletter and social feed for over 4 years. Track record: https://x.com/ethdaily
sections.why_grant: The distribution exists: 10,000 combined newsletter and podcast subscribers and 26,000 combined followers on X, Lens, and Farcaster (https://ethdaily.io/ads). Four years of coverage and a security archive are public. Nobody else funds this scope, which is why the price is $2,900 a month.
sections.commitments:
- Guides published under CC BY 4.0
- Paid referrals and sponsored listings are disclosed inline and never change what we recommend
- The hub is maintained for 12 months after the last milestone at no further cost
- Pinned target: at least 500 tracked clicks on tool links sent from the hub, guides, newsletter and podcast

milestones.name: Hub live
criteria: Hub live on ethdaily.io listing at least 8 tools and guides, checked by the technical reviewer
Neutrality policy live at https://ethdaily.io/terms and linked from the hub
Tracked link live for each listed tool

milestones.name: Tracked traffic to security tools
criteria: At least 500 unique clicks on tool links from the hub, guides, newsletter and podcast, with staff and obvious bot traffic excluded.
The count is shown in a public click report (clicks per tool link, from the link tracker’s dashboard or export).
The count verified by the technical reviewer from the link logs.

milestones.name: Sustainability
criteria: At least $1,000 of sponsorship or referral revenue, not counting grants, received from 1 outside project, shown on a revenue note and verified by the technical reviewer
